title: Show current marketing audience eligibility and exclusion reasons
detail: Existing campaign picker and compatibility count action use an authorized aggregate preview with matching contacts, eligible recipients and mutually exclusive invalid/duplicate/unknown-consent/unsubscribed/global-or-Space-suppressed/topic-muted exclusions. The existing audience grammar resolves the effective topic, preserving member-segment Marketing. Unknown consent remains excluded for every campaign topic. Count is disabled during changes and on policy read failures; exact contact count detects incomplete candidate reads. Send resolvers continue removing invalid/duplicate addresses. This closes only the integrated read-only preview subpacket. Full audience-eligibility packet remains unclosed until dispatch-policy and owner-only isolated test are implemented; no source.ref packet claim, no test sends or consent edits. Large/filter pagination beyond the existing resolver remains part of full campaign accounting.

verify.note: Direct shipped-code probe executes aggregate consent/exclusion accounting, scoped bounded policy reads/failure and real initial/member picker rendering. DB/action transports and UI primitives substituted; no child runner or live sends. Full58 focused tests, including async recovery/stale responses, remain CI-discovered.
